why: A value computed from process.stdout.columns at render time keeps its old width after a resize until the next keypress. In a React/Ink component the width is state updated by the resize handler.
good:
const [termWidth, setTermWidth] = useState(process.stdout.columns ?? 80);
useEffect(() => { const on = () => setTermWidth(process.stdout.columns ?? 80); process.stdout.on('resize', on); return () => { process.stdout.off('resize', on); }; }, []);
